# Scent World Canada

> Scent diffusers, fragrance oils and scent marketing for businesses
> and homes. Based in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Ships across Canada.

## What we sell
- Commercial scent diffusers for spaces of 500 to 5,000 sq ft
  (S30, S100, S200, S300). The S30, S200 and S300 connect to HVAC;
  the S200 and S300 have app control and an anti-theft lock.
- S20 Nano diffuser for single rooms up to 500 sq ft.
- Car scent diffuser and car diffuser gift set.
- 29 fragrance oils for diffusers.
- Custom signature scents and auto-refill delivery for businesses.
Current prices: https://www.scentworld.ca/shop

## Who we work with
Hotels, spas and wellness centres, restaurants, offices, retail and homes.

## Where we work
Based in Halifax, NS. Clients across Atlantic Canada, including Halifax,
Dartmouth, Bedford, Moncton, Fredericton and Charlottetown. We ship to
every Canadian province.

## Shipping and returns
Free shipping over $150 CAD in Canada. Orders processed in 24-48 hours
and delivered in 3-8 days, tracked. 30-day returns.

## Hours
Monday-Friday 9am-6pm Atlantic time. Weekends by appointment.
